title: TransactionRecord
description: Persisted transaction document including scoring result, triggered rules and evidence. Storage-oriented contract (Cosmos DB): 'id' equals transactionId to guarantee idempotency, 'accountId' is the partition key so the dominant query (recent transactions by account) hits a single partition.

id.description: Document id. MUST equal transactionId: a second insert of the same transaction conflicts instead of duplicating (idempotency).

transactionId.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned at ingestion.

accountId.description: Account that originated the transaction. Partition key.

correlationId.description: End-to-end correlation identifier propagated from ingestion through scoring, case management and monitoring.

category.description: Merchant category code or normalized category. Input for the risky-merchant rule.

location.description: Where the transaction happened. Input for the impossible-location rule.

channel.description: Channel through which the transaction was made.

occurredAt.description: When the transaction happened (client clock). Sort field of the dominant query.

receivedAt.description: When the ingestion API received the transaction (server clock).

status.description: Processing state: received (ingested, not yet scored), scored (scoring completed, score at or below threshold), case_requested (score exceeded the threshold and FraudCaseRequested was emitted).

scoring.description: Scoring result. Absent while status is 'received'; required once status is 'scored' or 'case_requested'.

score.description: Total score: sum of the points of every triggered rule.

threshold.description: Fraud threshold in effect when this transaction was scored. Persisted so cases remain explainable if configuration changes later.

isFraudSuspect.description: True when score > threshold. Per the specification a case opens only when the score exceeds the threshold.

engineVersion.description: Version of the scoring engine / rule set used.

triggeredRules.description: Rules that fired for this transaction. Empty array when no rule fired.

ruleId.description: The four rules of the specification (T-013).

points.description: Points this rule contributed to the total score.

evidence.description: Concrete data that made the rule fire, used by the case explainer. Shape per rule is defined in T-014; this contract only requires it to be a JSON object.
